info.title: Multi-Tenant Express API
info.description: Multi-tenant REST API with Organization → Project → Resource hierarchy, RBAC permissions, and invitation system.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Custom role and permission management within organizations

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invite users to organizations and projects

post.description: Register a new user account with an email address, display name, and password. The email is the unique login identifier and is trimmed and lowercased by the server before storage. Returns 400 if the email is already registered.

Authenticate with email and password. The submitted email is trimmed and lowercased before lookup, so casing does not matter. Server sets httpOnly cookies (access_token, refresh_token). After 5 consecutive failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes — locked accounts receive the same 401 response as invalid credentials to prevent enumeration.

200.description: Authentication successful. Auth tokens are set as httpOnly cookies.

get.description: Verify cookie validity and return the authenticated user's profile. Used by clients to check session status on startup.

post.description: Rotate tokens — revokes the current refresh token cookie and sets new httpOnly cookies.

200.description: Token refreshed successfully. New auth cookies are set.

Set-Cookie.description: Rotated httpOnly auth cookies (access_token and refresh_token)

post.description: Revoke the current refresh token. Idempotent — returns success even if the token is already revoked or missing.

200.description: Logged out successfully. Auth cookies are cleared.

post.description: Send an invitation to join an organization. The invitee is identified by email address, which is trimmed and lowercased by the server. A second pending invitation for the same email at the same scope is rejected with 400 — revoke the existing one first.

400.description: Validation error, user is already a member, or a pending invitation already exists for this email

duplicateInvitation.summary: A pending invitation already exists at this scope

value.message: A pending invitation already exists for this email

alreadyMember.summary: Invitee is already an organization member

value.message: User is already a member of this organization

get.description: Retrieve all invitations for an organization.

post.description: Send an invitation to join a project. The invitee is identified by email address, which is trimmed and lowercased by the server. A second pending invitation for the same email on the same project is rejected with 400; a pending org-level invitation for the same email does not block it.

400.description: Validation error, user is already a member, or a pending invitation already exists for this email

duplicateInvitation.summary: A pending invitation already exists at this scope

value.message: A pending invitation already exists for this email

alreadyMember.summary: Invitee is already a project member

value.message: User is already a member of this project

get.description: Retrieve all pending invitations for the authenticated user.

post.description: Accept a pending invitation to join an organization or project.

get.description: Public, token-gated preview of an invitation so a logged-out invitee can see what they were invited to before creating an account. Mounted above the authentication barrier — possession of the raw token is the only credential. Never returns the token or its hash. Returns 404 for both an unknown invitation and a wrong token, so the endpoint cannot be used to confirm that an invitation ID exists.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Raw invitation token — 64 lowercase hex characters

400.description: Malformed invitation ID or malformed token

invalidId.summary: Invitation ID is not a UUID

404.description: No such invitation, or the token does not match. The two cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: Revoke a pending invitation. Only users with appropriate permissions can revoke invitations.

post.description: Reissue a pending invitation: mints a fresh token, which invalidates the previous link, and resets the 7-day expiry. Only pending invitations can be resent — accepted and declined invitations are terminal. Requires the invitations:manage permission. Exists because the raw token is only ever returned at the moment it is minted, so a lost link would otherwise be unrecoverable while the duplicate guard blocks re-inviting the same address.

200.description: Invitation reissued successfully — the response carries the new raw token and accept URL

400.description: Malformed invitation ID, or the invitation is no longer pending

notPending.summary: Invitation was already accepted or declined

invalidId.summary: Invitation ID is not a UUID

404.description: No such invitation in this organization

get.description: Retrieve the full list of available permissions that can be assigned to roles.
Returns service health status. In production, uptime and database details are omitted. Mounted before rate limiting so load balancers are not throttled.

AccessToken.name: access_token
AccessToken.description: JWT access token (httpOnly cookie set by server)

RefreshToken.name: refresh_token
RefreshToken.description: JWT refresh token (httpOnly cookie set by server)

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation ID for request tracing. Accepts a valid UUID or generates one.

name.description: Display name. Not unique; never used as a login identifier.

email.description: Unique login identifier. Normalized to trimmed lowercase on write.

created_by.description: User ID of the organization creator
User ID of the project creator

user_id.description: User ID of the todo creator

is_system.description: Whether this is a system-defined role (cannot be modified or deleted)

permissions.description: List of permissions assigned to this role

project_id.description: Project the invitation is for (null for org-level invitations)

inviter_id.description: User ID of who sent the invitation

invitee_email.description: Email address the invitation was sent to, normalized to trimmed lowercase

invitee_id.description: User ID of the invited user, or null when no account exists for the invited email yet (pending-account invitation)

status.description: Stored invitation status. Only pending, accepted, and declined are ever written — expiry is derived from expires_at on read, and revoking hard-deletes the row rather than setting a status.

token.description: Raw invitation token. Returned only by the creation and resend responses — list responses omit it, since only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

accept_url.description: Absolute URL the invitee opens to accept. Built from APP_BASE_URL. Returned alongside the raw token only because the template ships no mail provider — remove both once delivery is wired.

inviter_name.description: Display name of the user who sent the invitation. Present only on list responses.

invitee_name.description: Display name of the invited user, or null when no account exists for the invited email yet. Present only on organization list responses.

InvitationPreview.description: Public, display-only projection of an invitation returned by the token-gated preview endpoint. Deliberately excludes token, token_hash, and every internal identifier other than the invitation's own ID.

org_name.description: Display name of the organization the invitation grants access to

project_name.description: Display name of the project, or null for an org-level invitation

inviter_name.description: Display name of the user who sent the invitation

invitee_email.description: Email address the invitation was sent to

is_expired.description: Whether expires_at has already elapsed. Derived at read time — expiry is never written back to the status column.

requires_signup.description: True when no account exists for invitee_email yet, so the invitee must register before they can accept

name.description: Display name (1-100 characters). Must not contain control or bidirectional-override characters.

email.description: Login identifier. Trimmed and lowercased by the server, so casing is not preserved.

password.description: Password (8-72 characters, must contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character)

email.description: Login identifier. Trimmed and lowercased by the server, so casing is not preserved.

RefreshResponseData.description: Empty — new tokens are set as httpOnly cookies, not returned in the body.

role_id.description: ID of the role to assign

permissions.description: Array of permission IDs to assign to the role
